elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) requires Vendor, upon expiry or termination for any reason and at Customer's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance. The request condition is Customer-controlled and does not defeat the assistance right.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) expressly states that assistance will be provided “at Vendor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires Vendor to return all Customer Data following expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days of expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) expressly requires return within thirty days of expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) uses the exact required format standard.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor thereafter to delete Customer Data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after return.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(c) requires Vendor to certify the deletion in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(a) creates this obligation at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The stated period of up to six months exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 10.3(b) requires return of all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format, which constitutes the required data export.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It adds only the exit-assistance, data-return, deletion, and certification mechanics needed by the rule, while leaving the existing delivery and refund provisions intact. The Customer-request qualifier is a practical, Customer-controlled activation mechanism rather than a material reduction of the transition-assistance right. The margin comment was not relied upon.
